title: Approve Borrowing Limits
description: Special resolution authorising the Board to borrow money beyond the paid-up capital and free reserves, up to a stated ceiling.
records: Register of Charges (if security is created)

questions.label: Maximum borrowing limit (Rs.)
questions.tooltip: Section 180(1)(c): borrowings beyond the aggregate of paid-up capital, free reserves and securities premium need a special resolution.

questions.label: Purpose of borrowing
questions.placeholder: e.g. working capital and business expansion

template.agendaTitle: To approve borrowing limits under Section 180(1)(c) of the Companies Act, 2013
template.proposal: At the {{agm_ordinal}} Annual General Meeting, the Board proposes that the members authorise borrowings up to Rs. {{borrowing_limit}} for {{borrowing_purpose}}. The members considered and, if thought fit, approved the following special resolution.
template.body:
"RESOLVED THAT pursuant to Section 180(1)(c) and other applicable provisions of the Companies Act, 2013, and in supersession of any earlier resolution, the consent of the members be and is hereby accorded to the Board of Directors to borrow, from time to time, any sum or sums of money which, together with the monies already borrowed by the Company (apart from temporary loans obtained from the Company's bankers in the ordinary course of business), may exceed the aggregate of the paid-up share capital, free reserves and securities premium of the Company, provided that the total amount so borrowed shall not at any time exceed Rs. {{borrowing_limit}}, for the purpose of {{borrowing_purpose}}.

RESOLVED FURTHER THAT the Board be and is hereby authorised to take all steps necessary to give effect to this resolution, including filing Form MGT-14 with the Registrar of Companies within thirty days."
template.explanatoryStatement: Section 180(1)(c) of the Companies Act, 2013 requires the consent of the members by special resolution before the Board borrows beyond the aggregate of the Company's paid-up share capital, free reserves and securities premium. The proposed ceiling of Rs. {{borrowing_limit}} is sought for {{borrowing_purpose}}. None of the Directors or Key Managerial Personnel is concerned or interested in this resolution except to the extent of their shareholding, if any.
template.minutesGist: Meeting held on {{meeting_date}} at {{meeting_place}}. The members considered the Board's proposal to authorise borrowings up to Rs. {{borrowing_limit}} for {{borrowing_purpose}} under Section 180(1)(c), and approved the special resolution above.

borrowing_limit.meaning: The overall ceiling on money the Board may borrow.
borrowing_limit.tip: A special resolution needs at least 75% of valid votes cast in favour.
